_comment: Permit data-source manifest for permit-search.html. The page loads this file at boot, then fetches every entry's `dataFile` in parallel and merges the permits into one searchable dataset. Each permit is tagged with the entry's `id` so the dataSource filter can scope results.

_schema.id: Stable identifier used as the dataSource tag on each permit (e.g. 'wpb', 'royal-palm-beach'). Don't rename after launch — it goes into shareable URLs.
_schema.label: Human-friendly name shown in the UI dropdown.
_schema.shortLabel: Compact tag shown in the results table 'Source' column.
_schema.county: Florida county the source belongs to (always 'Palm Beach' here).
_schema.city: Optional city name; matches the `city` field on each permit.
_schema.platform: Underlying portal platform (eDSWeb, Tyler EnerGov, Click2Gov, SagesGov, ...).
_schema.dataFile: Relative path to the JSON file (same shape as palm-beach.json).
_schema.portalUrl: Public portal URL for one-off lookups.
_schema.status: active | scaffold | manual | unsupported_paywall — drives banner color and warning copy.
_schema.scope: Free-text description of what's actually in the dataFile.

sources.label: Palm Beach County (unincorporated)
sources.scope: Legacy eDSWeb scraper is DEFUNCT (county migrated 2024). Sample data only; use the portal manually for live lookups.

sources.label: West Palm Beach
sources.scope: Live Tyler EnerGov scrape, 90-day apply-date window (capped at 4,000 most-recent permits). No contractor/valuation in public API; use portal link for those.

sources.label: Boca Raton
sources.scope: Live Tyler EnerGov scrape, 90-day apply-date window. No contractor/valuation in public API.

sources.label: Jupiter
sources.scope: Live Tyler EnerGov scrape, 90-day apply-date window. No contractor/valuation in public API.

sources.label: St. Lucie County
sources.scope: Most recent 4,000 permits sorted by apply date (SLC's API ignores date filter, so cap gives ~3 months of unincorporated St. Lucie County data).

sources.label: Royal Palm Beach
sources.scope: Click2Gov has no bulk listing; new submissions go through ProjectDox which requires an account. Sample data only — use the portal link directly.

sources.label: Boynton Beach
sources.scope: SagesGov requires login for search and is anti-bot. Sample data only — no public bulk export.
